I can't confirm that for the full period. The evidence is rated "insufficient evidence" because of a temporal gap.

**What it shows:** FIRMS recorded zero thermal detections intersecting ASSET-F14 (2026-10-13 to 2026-11-12) on all days that were covered. MODIS, VIIRS NOAA-20 and VIIRS NOAA-21 covered the whole period. VIIRS S-NPP covered everything except 2 to 6 November 2026, when its data wasn't available from the FIRMS area API.

**Caveat:** Because S-NPP is missing for those days, the full period doesn't meet the rule that every sensor must cover every day. The other three sensors did cover those days and showed nothing, but the evidence doesn't treat that as full confirmation.

**Also note:** Zero detections doesn't prove no fire occurred, since small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can be missed. It also says nothing about burned area or about dates outside the period.
